newsitem.title: USA: First Southern Bancshares sets special div.
newsitem.headline: First Southern Bancshares sets special div.

text.p: First Southern Bancshares Inc said on Thursday that it set a special dividend of $2.00 per share on its outstanding common stock to shareholders of record as of November 26.
The dividend will be payable on December 6.

The company said it has been advised that a significant portion of the special dividend will represent a non-taxable return of capital that would result in a reduction in the cost basis of each share.
The exact amount of the distribution that could be considered non-taxable will be determined after First Southern's 1996 results of operations have been finalized.
First Southern Bancshares is the holding company for First Southern Bank, an Alabama-chartered commercial bank.
